caption: The drawing depicts a wooden rocking horse toy shown in profile view, facing left. The body of the rocking horse is predominantly light brown with subtle wood grain textures, and is decorated with irregular, faded gray and dark spots distributed across its surface. The head is shaped to resemble a horse, painted a lighter shade with several gray spots. The rocker base curves smoothly on both ends and is similarly adorned with spots, with the ends slightly darker. There is a small, dark-colored saddle positioned at the top of the body, with what appears to be a dark brown patch or covering directly in front of the saddle, possibly representing a worn or textured area. The drawing is set against a plain, off-white background without any additional objects or elements.
title: Wooden Rocking Horse
